messages:
Maya (support): FYI — receiving 3 tickets in the last hour where support console shows 'Grant successful' but users still have 0 credits. Accounts: 0xA3f, 0xB72, 0xC11. :confused:
Raj (eng): Can you paste the console action id or a screenshot? Is the support tool returning a 200 or timing out?
Maya (support): UI toast says success. No error in UI. I grabbed the action id from the modal: actionId=apply-credit-2026-03-17-9f3c
Lena (backoffice): Looking at backoffice logs for that id shows: `202 ACCEPTED -> queued` then nothing. No ledger write.
Oliver (eng-sre): Hmm, we had a deploy ~30m ago to the backoffice worker pool (deploy-bot: deploy/backsrv v3.14.2). Could be the worker not dequeuing messages. @deploy-bot anything in pipeline?
deploy-bot: deploy/backsrv v3.14.2 rolled at 1825002150 by raj. Health checks passed. No recent restarts recorded.
Raj (eng): I see the async-processor has ~1500 pending jobs in the Redis list for the credit-apply queue. Workers are up but their process logs show repeated 504s to /ledger/write endpoint. Example error: `UpstreamError: net/http: timeout awaiting response headers`
Lena (backoffice): That explains the ACk loop. Backoffice marks request accepted, but when ledger write fails we currently leave the job un-acked so support console shows success but ledger never updated.
Maya (support): Two customers escalated to SOC — they expect credits now. Any short-term workaround we can do from support?
Oliver (eng-sre): Workaround: manual ledger insertion via admin CLI is possible but risky. If you need immediate relief do this: `admin-ledger create --acct 0xA3f --amount 50 --meta "support-grant-temp"` then DM me so I can watch for duplicate reconciliation. Use MFA.
Sam (product): We should probably change the UI to not show 'Grant successful' until ledger write confirmed. That messaging mismatch is causing churn.
Raj (eng): Agreed. Quick queue mitigation: increase ledger service connect timeout and add exponential retry on the worker so it doesn't leave jobs pending forever. I'll push a small patch to bump timeout from 5s -> 15s and add retries in the worker.
Lena (backoffice): I can add a post-accept audit marker so support gets a 'pending' state instead of success until ledger ack.
Maya (support): I'll follow up the three tickets with the manual CLI workaround for now and note that it's being escalated to eng.
Oliver (eng-sre): Patch pushed to staging. Rolling to prod in 10. I'll watch the redis queue drain.
Raj (eng): Patch pushed, config updated, restarting one worker to pick it up.
Oliver (eng-sre): After restart, queue processed and ledger writes resumed. Confirmed ledger entries for 0xA3f and 0xB72. Remaining one 0xC11 processed at 1825004522.
Maya (support): Confirmed with customer 0xA3f — credits visible. Closing ticket. Thanks team :tada:
Sam (product): Follow-ups: change UI toast logic, add metric for 'grant success vs ledger ack' ratio, and postmortem for the deploy that reduced worker timeouts. I'll file a ticket.
Raj (eng): I'll open a PR to add retries + better error handling and link Sam's ticket.
Lena (backoffice): Adding audit flag and will update support docs with temp CLI steps.
Maya (support): Great. Please ping in #support when the UI change is live so we can update canned responses.
Oliver (eng-sre): Marking incident resolved. Root cause: deployed worker config + low ledger timeout leading to un-acked jobs and UI mismatch.
Maya (support): Thanks.
